archives.title: Archive
archives.hint: Archived ideas no longer appear on the public list.

categories.typesHint: Click a chip to rename. Press Enter to add.
categories.peopleHint: Specific to this list. Click to rename, × to remove (if no ideas use them).

share.title: Share
share.description: The read link can't edit the list.
share.inviteHint: An account that opens it becomes a member. Click the field or button to copy.
share.inviteEmailHint: Sends the invite link. They need a Wishlist account.
share.readPasswordHint: Optional. Without a password, the URL is enough. With one, visitors need the URL and the password.
share.readPasswordSet: This list is protected. Entering a new password replaces it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Categories, people, and sensitive actions on this list.
settings.appearanceHint: Title, subtitle, colors, and illustration on the public page.
settings.subtitle: Subtitle
settings.subtitleHint: Text under the title. Leave empty to hide it.
settings.subtitlePlaceholder: e.g. Our Christmas gift ideas — click a category to jump.
settings.colorsHint: Primary = buttons / gift body. Accent = alerts / lid. Highlight = stars / ribbon.
settings.coverImageHint: http(s) URL. Empty = gift mark in this list's colors.

kanban.hint: Drag an idea between categories. Click a card to edit it.
